name: Fakir Karunaratne-Appiah
description:
Fakir Karunaratne-Appiah is the PI that fraud investigators dream of and fraudsters have nightmares about — a methodical, meticulous, mathematically minded investigator who specializes in the art of proving that the numbers don't lie, even when people do.

His professional life is insurance fraud. He works on retainer for three of GLMZ's largest insurance underwriters and two corporate risk assessment firms, investigating claims that statistical analysis has flagged as potentially fraudulent. His cases range from individual claimants faking cyberware injuries to elaborate multi-year fraud operations involving dozens of participants and millions of Quanta. He approaches every case with the same patient methodology: gather the numbers, analyze the patterns, find the anomaly, prove the fraud.

The mundanity of his work is his greatest asset. Nobody pays attention to the insurance investigator. He moves through corporate offices, medical facilities, repair shops, and financial institutions with the invisibility of someone who belongs everywhere and nowhere. His interviews are so bland that subjects relax and contradict themselves. His reports are so thorough that legal challenges are futile. He is not exciting, not dramatic, and not interested in being either. He is simply very, very good at mathematics, and in a city built on financial transactions, mathematics is power.
location: A boring office in Glassway designed to be forgettable — beige walls, standard furniture, nothing that reveals personality, near Milwaukee and North Ave
specialization: Insurance fraud investigation and financial crime analysis
methods: Statistical analysis of claim patterns to identify anomalies
Forensic accounting — following money through complex financial structures
Scene reconstruction — determining whether an incident matches the filed claim
Behavioral analysis of claimants using standardized interview protocols
Cross-referencing claim histories across multiple insurance providers to identify serial fraudsters
notable_cases: Identified a fraud ring that had filed Φ47 million in false cyberware malfunction claims across twelve insurance providers over four years
Proved that a 'destroyed' warehouse full of pharmaceutical inventory had actually been emptied and sold on the black market before a conveniently timed fire
Exposed a doctor who was performing unnecessary surgeries and filing insurance claims for procedures that never happened — affecting over 300 patients
equipment: Custom financial analysis software that can process millions of transactions and flag anomalies
Forensic scene reconstruction tools — scanners, measurement devices, material analysis equipment
Database access to major insurance claim repositories — legitimate, paid for by retainer clients
A deliberately unremarkable appearance — he can enter any corporate environment without being noticed
Voice stress analysis software integrated into his BCI — detects deception during interviews
personality: Cezar is Romanian-Japanese-Ghanaian, forty-two years old, average height, average build, average face — a man engineered by genetics and choice to be forgettable, and he has weaponized that forgettability into a career. He is methodical, patient, and finds genuine pleasure in the mathematics of fraud — the patterns, the anomalies, the moment when numbers that are supposed to add up don't. He is the least dramatic PI in GLMZ and is fine with that. His cases don't involve shootouts or car chases; they involve spreadsheets and depositions and the quiet satisfaction of proving that someone lied with numbers. He has no enemies because nobody considers him a threat until it's too late.

relationships.name: Dr. Solene Gutierrez-Appiah
relationships.description: A medical professional he consults on healthcare fraud cases — provides the clinical knowledge he lacks

relationships.name: Hafsteinn Karlsen-Boateng
relationships.description: Refers corporate fraud cases down to Cezar when they're beneath her tier — he refers corporate espionage up to her when they're above his

story_hooks: A routine insurance fraud investigation uncovers a financial pattern so large and so systemic that it suggests one of the insurance companies he works for is itself the fraud
A fraudster he exposed five years ago has rebuilt their operation on a scale that makes the original look like practice — and they've designed it specifically to be invisible to his methods

Cezar discovers that the statistical analysis tools he's been using for a decade contain a hidden bias that has caused him to miss a specific type of fraud — and now he has to determine how many cases he got wrong

physical_description.heritage: South Asian (49%), Sub-Saharan African (35.5%), and Southeast Asian (15.5%) mixed ancestry. The dominant South Asian heritage provides warm undertones and refined facial structure; substantial Sub-Saharan African ancestry contributes rich skin depth, prominent cheekbone geometry, and facial bone structure; Southeast Asian heritage adds subtle eye shape characteristics and softer facial contours. The combination creates a complex warm medium-brown complexion with golden-amber undertones, well-defined cheekbones with strong definition, and balanced facial proportions that reflect this tri-continental blend.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with the posture of someone who spends twelve hours a day hunched over terminals. Shoulders slightly forward, minimal musculature — functional rather than maintained.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Short, neatly parted, maintained with professional precision
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden-amber undertones, reflecting the balanced blend of South Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and Southeast Asian ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven, minimal facial hair. Skin shows slight pallor from indoor work with warm golden undertones beneath. Facial features reflect the ancestry blend: strong, well-defined cheekbones from African heritage providing structure and prominence, straight nose with refined bridge showing South Asian influence, and eye shape displaying Southeast Asian genetic characteristics with slightly wider-set placement. No visible scars or marks except the characteristic jawline scar. Expression resting at neutral — the face of someone who has learned not to show reactions.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along left jawline, approximately 3cm, from a childhood accident — barely visible unless light hits at specific angle
Faint calluses on fingers and the side of his right hand from years of handwritten note-taking and stylus work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. All augmentations are subcutaneous or internal — likely a neural interface for data analysis and financial system access, but no external chrome or LED modifications.
physical_description.posture_movement: Deliberate and economical. Moves with minimal wasted motion. Sits with perfect posture at a terminal but slouches slightly when walking, as if conserving energy for thought. Hands move with precision when gesturing — no flourish, no emphasis, just necessary communication.
physical_description.clothing_style: Aggressively forgettable. Gray or navy slacks, white or light blue dress shirts, dark blazers from mid-tier retailers (Nexus Professional, Meridian). No logos, no chrome accents, no smart-fabric displays. Shoes are black leather, well-maintained but unremarkable. Watch is a simple digital with no AR functions — practical, not status-signaling. Dresses for Tier 3 corporate environments deliberately, never standing out.
